meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (Napoleonic tradition; Article 2 of the 2014 Constitution declares Islamic Sharia a principal source of legislation; unitary national system with no sub-state tax autonomy)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law No. 80 of 2002 on Combating Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing, as last amended by Law No. 34 of 2022; Cabinet Decree No. 56 of 2021 on the Registration of Ultimate Beneficial Owners (UBO) with GAFI and the Egyptian Tax Authority; Executive Regulations of the AML Law issued by Prime Ministerial Decree No. 65 of 2019 (amending Ministerial Decree No. 8 of 2003); Companies Law No. 159 of 1981 (Arts. 48-79 governing LLCs); Executive Regulations of the Companies Law (Ministerial Decree No. 6 of 1982); Investment Law No. 72 of 2017 and Executive Regulations (Prime Ministerial Decree No. 2310 of 2017); Commercial Register Law No. 34 of 1976.
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access - UBO declarations under Cabinet Decree No. 56 of 2021 are confidential and not part of the open commercial file; access is granted to the Money Laundering Combating Unit (MLCU), Central Bank of Egypt, Egyptian Tax Authority, GAFI supervisory officers, and other designated AML/CFT supervisors.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of the passport of each shareholder and manager (foreign nationals) or national ID (Egyptian nationals)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport Authority / Civil Status Authority of the shareholder's country of residence; certification by a local notary public
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization - Egypt is not a party to the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention; chain: local notary attestation -> Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the issuing state -> consular legalization by the Embassy of Egypt -> post-arrival attestation by the Egyptian Ministry of Foreign Affairs -> sworn Arabic translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Conduct / Police Clearance Certificate of each foreign shareholder and manager
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National criminal records bureau or police authority of the country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization - local MFA authentication -> Egyptian Consulate legalization -> Egyptian MFA re-attestation -> certified Arabic translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter confirming financial standing, source of funds, and absence of adverse screening results for each shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Commercial bank maintaining the shareholder's account in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization - notarization of bank officer's signature -> country MFA authentication -> Egyptian consular legalization -> Arabic translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board resolution of each corporate shareholder authorizing the incorporation of the Egyptian LLC, appointing its managers, and identifying its UBOs
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate secretary / board of directors of the corporate shareholder in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization - company seal and director signature notarized locally -> country MFA authentication -> Egyptian consular legalization -> sworn Arabic translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Power of Attorney appointing the resident Egyptian incorporation attorney and designated signatory
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the country of origin (or Egyptian Notary Public if signed in Egypt)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization - local notarization -> issuing state MFA -> Egyptian Consulate legalization -> Egyptian MFA attestation -> Arabic translation

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-incorporation screening of all shareholders, managers, and UBOs against the MLCU (Egyptian Financial Intelligence Unit) restricted lists, CBE sanctions database, UN Security Council Consolidated List (resolutions 1267/1989, 1988, 1718), OFAC SDN list, EU consolidated financial sanctions list, and HMT equivalent; politically exposed persons (PEPs) and their family/close associates are declared in the UBO filing form and are subject to enhanced due diligence (EDD) as prescribed by Articles 3, 7, and 8 of Law No. 80 of 2002; adverse hits require a reasoned legal opinion and may bar the nomination of the affected individual as manager or shareholder.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: GAFI One-Stop-Shop (OSS) and online investor portal of the General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (https://gafi.gov.eg / https://investinegypt.gov.eg), integrated with the Ministry of Justice and the Commercial Registry
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The legal company name must be written in Arabic script in the Commercial Register; a transliterated Latin name may appear in parentheses as a trading name but has no controlling legal effect. The Arabic name must be differentiated from existing registered names and famous trademarks and must not be misleading as to the object or legal form; the name of an LLC must end with the letters 'ذ.م.م.' (LLC).
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If commercially rejected, GAFI issues a written refusal notice. The applicant may file an administrative reconsideration request with GAFI's Legal Affairs Department within 15 days, attaching the search certificate and evidence of trademark ownership or consent. If the refusal is sustained, the aggrieved party may lodge an administrative appeal with the GAFI Vice Chairman for Legal Affairs within 30 days and thereafter challenge the decision before the Administrative Court of the Council of State under Law No. 47 of 1972. A name reservation may be extended once for an additional 30 days by written request submitted before expiry.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permissible as the sole registered office. GAFI and the Commercial Registry require a physical Egyptian address, verifiable by lease contract, at which statutory books, corporate records, and accounting documents are kept and at which process may be served. A virtual office may serve only as a supplementary correspondence address for a low-risk toy assembly business.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low-to-moderate quantified risk: approximately 20-25% probability of an unannounced GAFI or Commercial Registry physical inspection within the first 12 months; the probability rises to 35-40% over a 3-year horizon if on-site verification is triggered by social insurance audits, ETA tax inspections, or targeted MLCU AML offsite reviews for cash-intensive operations.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: GAFI investment file opening, docket number issuance, and commercial name clearance/reservation fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under GAFI fee schedule issued pursuant to Investment Law No. 72 of 2017 and its Executive Regulations

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Legal counsel fees: drafting of the LLC Memorandum and Articles of Association (contractual deed), UBO declaration forms, manager nomination resolutions, and legal due diligence opinion under Law No. 159 of 1981
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: External law firm (Egyptian licensed attorneys admitted to the Egyptian Bar Association)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for a standard LLC incorporation with one corporate shareholder (approx. EGP 24,000-28,000)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarial authentication of the Articles of Association before the Egyptian Notary Public (Mamlaka) and certified Arabic translation of foreign corporate documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Ministry of Justice - Notarial Affairs (Tawthiq Mahallah)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory notarial stamp tariffs under Notary Law No. 68 of 1947 plus prevailing translation market rates (approx. EGP 500-1,200 per page)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Commercial registration entry fee in the Egyptian Commercial Register (including certificate of incorporation and extract)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff prescribed under Commercial Register Law No. 34 of 1976 and Ministry of Trade and Industry fee decrees

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Publication of the incorporation notice in the Official Gazette (Al-Waqa'i Al-Masriya)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Official Gazette Authority (Al-Waqa'i Al-Masriya), General Organization for Government Printing Affairs
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory publication tariff based on notice length and page count (approx. EGP 2,500-3,500)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Tax registration (Tax Card) through the ETA Saleem e-portal and UBO register filing fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) and the Ministry of Finance UBO database under Cabinet Decree No. 56 of 2021
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory administrative fee; the Tax Card issuance itself is free, with nominal UBO registration fees collected electronically

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Contingency reserve for certified translation of legalized documents, courier/DHL consular submission charges, and GAFI notary visits
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: External certified translation offices and logistics service providers
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark; approximate cost for 10-15 pages of certified translation plus logistics

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Egyptian Companies Law No. 159 of 1981, Articles 102-127 (Limited Liability Companies), as amended by Law No. 4 of 2009; Investment Law No. 72 of 2017 (one-stop-shop unified registration); Commercial Registry Law No. 34 of 1976.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: General Authority for Investment and Foreign Trade (GAFI), Investor Services Center / One-Stop-Shop, Cairo; Commercial Registry Office under the Ministry of Supply and Internal Trade.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Notarized Articles of Association ('Aqd Ta'sis) submitted with the GAFI Incorporation Application Form and supporting shareholder KYC dossiers.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital for LLCs under Law No. 159 of 1981; the share capital must be fully subscribed by the founding members and paid into a temporary corporate bank account, evidenced by a capital deposit certificate; non-resident shareholders may hold 100% of the LLC quotas.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the initial share capital, fully subscribed by the founding members under the Articles of Association executed pursuant to Companies Law No. 159 of 1981, is hereby ratified and accepted by the Board. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the registered head office is adopted at the Company's premises located in Cairo, Egypt, within the Commercial Registry jurisdiction, where statutory notices shall be served. RESOLVED FURTHER, that [Name A] is appointed Managing Manager and [Name B] Deputy Manager, each with full authority to represent the Company, operate banking accounts, and complete filings before GAFI, the Tax Authority, social insurance and licensing bodies. RESOLVED FURTHER, that management shall procure all statutory registrations, industrial licenses, insurance, and lease agreements required for commencement of operations.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Reservation and GAFI One-Stop-Shop Incorporation Filing
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI Investor Services Center (One-Stop-Shop), Cairo; online portal at gafi.gov.eg
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Reserve the proposed company name through the GAFI electronic name reservation service. After preliminary approval, execute the Articles of Association in Arabic before a notary, complete the incorporation application prescribed by the Executive Regulations of Investment Law No. 72 of 2017, execute KYC/UBO declarations for all members and managers, and submit the complete charter dossier for statutory review and approval.
required_dossiers: Four copies of the draft Articles of Association in Arabic
Passport or national ID copies of all shareholders and managers
KYC and ultimate beneficial owner declarations
Power of attorney if an agent acts on behalf of shareholders
Bank reference letters or source of funds documentation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If GAFI raises a query or rejects the filing, correct the specified defects and re-file within 30 days. A written appeal may be lodged with the GAFI Investor Complaints Unit, which is required to decide within 15 working days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notarization of Articles of Association and Bank Capital Deposit
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI Legal Department / Notary Public Office (Al-Shahr Al-Aqari); commercial bank in Egypt
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Attest the Articles of Association and the managers' acceptance statements before the competent notarial office. Open a temporary corporate bank account and deposit the fully subscribed share capital, then obtain a capital deposit certificate in the company's name evidencing the credited funds, which will be released upon issuance of the commercial registration certificate.
required_dossiers: Notarized draft Articles of Association
Shareholders' identity documents and KYC declarations
Provisional head-office lease contract
Bank account application and notarized board resolution
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Notarial refusal based on documentary defects may be cured by resubmitting a fully corrected bilingual charter. Capital re-deposit or transfer between branches of the same bank is permitted without regulatory penalty where no third-party objections exist.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Commercial Registration and Unified Investment Certificate Issuance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Commercial Registry Office, Ministry of Supply and Internal Trade; GAFI One-Stop-Shop
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply at the Commercial Registry under Law No. 34 of 1976 to obtain the company's commercial registration number. Simultaneously obtain the Unified Investment Certificate from GAFI, which consolidates commercial registration, tax and employment data, and verify that the registered business code reflects ISIC 3240 (manufacture of games and toys).
required_dossiers: Notarized Articles of Association
Capital deposit certificate from the bank
Head-office lease contract or title deed
GAFI incorporation approval letter
Managers' identity copies and signed acceptance letters
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Commercial Registry objections regarding registration data mismatches are cured by filing an amended commercial registry notification with corrected particulars. The company may seek administrative reconsideration before the Ministry of Supply or commence an administrative court action within 60 days of refusal.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Registration and Tax Card Issuance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA), local tax office (Ma'mouriyat) of the company's address
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the tax registration application to obtain the Tax Card (Bitaqa Dharibiya). Register for corporate income tax under Law No. 91 of 2005, value-added tax under Law No. 67 of 2016, payroll tax, and stamp tax. Ensure the lease contract and the ISIC 3240 activity description are recorded in the tax file.
required_dossiers: Commercial registration certificate
Notarized Articles of Association
Lease contract or ownership proof of premises
Bank capital deposit certificate
Identity copies of the manager and shareholders
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Tax office suspension due to incomplete premises documentation is cured by submitting the final lease authenticated by the local district office. An objecting taxpayer may file an appeal under Law No. 91 of 2005 within 30 days of any adverse registration or deemed assessment decision.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: National Organization for Social Insurance (NOSI), local branch of the company's address
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the LLC with NOSI under Social Insurance Law No. 148 of 2019, obtain a social insurance registration number, and file the initial workforce statement listing the managing manager and any prospective employees. Monthly contribution declarations commence once the company establishes its payroll roster.
required_dossiers: Commercial registration certificate
Tax card
Manager's national ID copy
Notarized manager appointment resolution
Company stamp and registration application form
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If NOSI flags under-declared salaries, file corrected contribution declarations supported by payroll contracts before the next due date. Late registration fines may be waived upon a written request demonstrating that the delay was caused by registry or documentary processing delays.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Local Facility License Application for the Production Workspace
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI One-Stop-Shop licensing window jointly with the Municipality, Industrial Development Authority and Civil Defense authorities
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the facility license application for the identified production workspace, attaching the fire-safety extraction plan for the CO2 laser station, lease records, environmental screening documents, municipal zoning clearance, and structural load documentation. The licensing authority coordinates with the Industrial Development Authority, Civil Defense and the Egyptian Environmental Affairs Agency.
required_dossiers: Lease contract and building title or zoning approval
Civil Defense fire-safety application and site plan
Environmental Annex II registration or EIA brief approval
Structural load / building stability certificate
Industrial activity index reflecting ISIC 3240 per IDA nomenclature
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: A facility license refusal may be cured by rectifying zoning or safety remarks. The applicant may invoke the 30-day statutory objection procedure before the Investment Licensing Committee, and a provisional operating permit may be issued for low-risk operations pending the final environmental certificate.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Industrial Development Authority (IDA) in coordination with the GAFI Facility Licensing One-Stop-Shop
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Industrial Facility License (Rokhsat Tashghil Sina'i) and Unified Facility Operating Certificate issued under Investment Law No. 72 of 2017, together with IDA industrial registration (Qaid Sina'i) for ISIC 3240 - Precision CO2 Laser Cutting of 3D Mechanical Wooden Puzzles.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category B (Annex II) - brief Environmental Assessment required under Environmental Law No. 4 of 1994 and Ministerial Decree No. 977 of 2015. Wooden toy and game manufacturing with laser cutting and non-halogenated adhesives is registered through the simplified 'visual appraisal' route; operations exceeding 5 kW installed laser power or employing industrial paint/stain lines may be upgraded to a full Environmental Impact Assessment.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater discharged to public sewer must comply with Law No. 93 of 1962 parameters: BOD not exceeding 300 mg/L, TSS not exceeding 300 mg/L, oil and grease not exceeding 50 mg/L, pH within 6-9. Air emissions from the laser extraction stack must not exceed 100 mg/Nm3 of particulate matter; workplace respirable wood dust must be maintained at or below 5 mg/m3 TLV and formaldehyde at or below 0.75 ppm. Captured sawdust and laser-charred residues must be collected dry and disposed of as non-hazardous solid waste unless chemically treated.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Civil Defense fire-safety certificate covering the CO2 laser station, including Class B and Class C fire extinguishers, spark-prevention extraction filters, 1-hour fire-rated escape routes, emergency lighting, and an evacuation plan. A structural load inspection by a licensed engineer must confirm floor loading for machinery. Occupational safety clearance under Labor Law No. 12 of 2003 and Ministerial Decree No. 211 of 2014 must verify machine guarding, laser enclosure interlocks, personal protective equipment, and permit-to-work procedures for laser maintenance.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA), Nasr City, Cairo; unified tax registration portal at www.eta.gov.eg and e-invoicing services at einvoice.eta.gov.eg.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1: Incorporate the LLC and obtain the commercial registry extract and tax card application from the GAFI one-stop shop. Step 2: Submit the articles of association, commercial registry certificate, lease or title deed of the Egyptian premises, and passport/civil ID of the manager to the competent local tax office (Ma'mouria) to obtain the unified Tax Identification Number (TIN), within 30 days of incorporation. Step 3: File the VAT registration application with the ETA VAT Division if annual taxable supplies exceed EGP 500,000, or voluntarily for a below-threshold exporter. Step 4: Register on the ETA e-invoicing platform and obtain API client credentials. Step 5: Obtain an exporter customs code through the ACI/NAFEZA portal to execute export declarations. The TIN is a single unified number covering corporate income tax, VAT, withholding tax, and payroll taxes.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation: The Egyptian LLC is a resident juridical person subject to corporate income tax at 22.5% on worldwide income; no pass-through or transparent entity election exists for LLCs under Egyptian law. Dividends are subject to a 10% withholding tax at distribution. The territorial scope is a modified worldwide method with foreign tax credit; income of an Egyptian resident LLC earned abroad through a permanent establishment is generally taxable in Egypt with unilateral credit relief.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or hybrid mismatch election exists in Egyptian tax law. The ETA applies substance-over-form, effective management (Egyptian 'center of management'), and the 'subject to tax' condition under Article 50 of the Tax Procedures Law 206/2020, which denies deduction of payments to a non-resident entity if the amount is not subject to tax at a comparable level in the foreign jurisdiction. Elections are limited to the grouping of tax periods, the simplified small-taxpayer regime, and the VAT refund option for zero-rated suppliers; no protective passthrough elections are available to a single-member LLC.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under Egyptian Law No. 67 of 2016 as amended by Law 449/2020 and Executive Decree 57/2022.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: EGP 500,000 annual taxable turnover (mandatory); voluntary registration allowed below threshold, including for zero-rated exporters seeking refunds; a presumptive simplified small-taxpayer regime applies to qualifying businesses with turnover up to EGP 2 million under Law 152/2020, but it does not override the exporter's zero-rating rights.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory real-time e-invoicing for all B2B exports and domestic sales: the taxpayer must push every invoice to ETA via API (XML/JSON) for real-time clearance and receipt of a UUID and QR code before the transaction is considered compliant; e-receipts are mandatory for B2C sales since tax phase 2022; all exported goods must also obtain an ACI number via the NAFEZA one-stop customs portal at least 48 hours before loading; non-compliance triggers the penalty scale under Article 40 of VAT Law 67/2016 (EGP 50,000 to EGP 2,000,000 per violation) and the per se disallowance of input VAT deduction on non-cleared invoices.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of physical goods (including CO2-laser-cut wooden puzzles) are zero-rated under Article 16 of Law 67/2016 provided the exporter submits: an authenticated customs export declaration proving physical departure from Egypt, transport documents, sales contract bearing international trade clauses, and proof that the consideration has been received from a non-resident in foreign currency (or in EGP through the official banking channel). Offshore services consumed outside Egypt also qualify for zero-rating. The claim is substantiated through an 'export proof file' that must be preserved for at least 5 years and is audited by the ETA before any refund is authorized.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (بيان تصدير) authenticated by the Egyptian Customs Authority through the NAFEZA/ACI system
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill issued by an international carrier
Inward Remittance Certificate issued by the Egyptian bank confirming receipt and crediting of the export proceeds in foreign currency
Certificate of Export Proceeds (Form 4) issued by the exporter's bank confirming collection of the payment and legation with the Central Bank of Egypt repatriation rules
Sales contract (translated legalized copy), commercial invoice, and packing list
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The ETA and Central Bank of Egypt cross-check export files with NAFEZA shipment data, bank-backed reporting, and customs exit records; any false or inflated zero-rating claim triggers: (i) full refund clawback with additional penalty of 50% to 170% of the VAT refunded (Article 40 VAT Law); (ii) reversal of the zero rate and assessment of 14% VAT with delay interest computed at 2% per month (minimum EGP 100 and capped at 100% of the tax); (iii) criminal liability, including imprisonment and confiscation, in cases of forged documents or fraudulent export schemes; (iv) suspension of the exporter's tax card and e-invoicing certificate, with the manager and licensed tax adviser held jointly liable under the Tax Procedures Law 206/2020.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Egypt (CBE), also exercising foreign exchange administration authority under Law No. 194 of 2020 (Central Bank and Banking System Law) and the Egyptian Investment Law No. 72 of 2017.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Egypt maintains de jure current account convertibility for EGP, having accepted IMF Article VIII obligations; the CBE liberalised the exchange rate in March 2024 and now operates a flexible, interbank-driven currency regime. Capital account transactions are not fully convertible: inward FDI and foreign borrowing must be routed through CBE-licensed banks and registered with GAFI (General Authority for Investment). Profit remittance is permitted without prior CBE approval only where the foreign investment has been properly registered, foreign currency entered Egypt through the banking system, corporate tax and 10% dividend withholding tax have been settled, and audited financial statements support the dividend distribution.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: As of the March 2024 FX reform, no statutory percentage of export proceeds must be converted into EGP; the CBE rescinded the earlier incremental surrender ratios (5%-15%) in January 2023. Exporters must still channel all export proceeds through an Egyptian bank and receive the funds into a foreign currency account within the statutory repatriation period of 90 days from the bill of lading date (extendable in documented exceptional cases). Proceeds may be retained in USD/EUR, used for import settlements, or sold into EGP at the prevailing interbank rate.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account (EGP/FX) and Operational Current Account (EGP/EUR/USD)
Capital Escrow Account and Operational Current Account
Investment Registration Account and Operational Current Account
Capital Escrow Account and Operational Current Account
Operational Current Account with FX sub-ledger

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: LOW for primary treasury and Egyptian IBAN services; MEDIUM for ancillary offshore collection. Offshore digital EMIs such as Wise, Revolut, Payoneer, or MultiPass cannot obtain an Egyptian banking or e-money licence without a locally incorporated, CBE-licensed entity, and are prohibited from issuing Egyptian IBANs under Law No. 194 of 2020 and Law No. 18 of 2019 on Non-Cash Payments. They may be used only as offshore USD/EUR settlement conduits, with all statutory trade proceeds and tax commitments ultimately cleared through the Egyptian banking system.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is mandatory: the authorised manager and the Ultimate Beneficial Owner must attend the branch in person to sign the account opening file and complete the mandatory compliance interview. Non-resident directors may pre-certify passports, powers of attorney, and constitutional documents via notarisation and consular legalisation/apostille, but a final biometric identity verification at an Egyptian branch is mandatory for the signatories. CBE AML/CFT rules under Law No. 80 of 2002 require face-to-face UBO identification; pure video-based remote onboarding is not recognised for corporate accounts.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions-name-match or adverse media triggered by Chinese or Gulf-region intermediary suppliers of CO2 laser machinery and MDF board.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Dossier comprising the original purchase contract, supplier KYB registration certificate, export licence from the supplier jurisdiction, bill of lading and AWB records, marine/freight insurance policy, pro-forma invoice, and a board resolution identifying the ultimate equipment user and Egyptian factory address.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Transaction-profile anomaly from Amazon Pay and Stripe settlement streams bearing marketplaces in the United States, EU, and MENA while the entity is a newly capitalised LLC.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Dossier comprising three months of consolidated Amazon/Stripe merchant payout statements, platform seller tax registrations, Fulfilment-by-Merchant shipment logs, matched VAT/EGP sales tax returns, the e-commerce logistics framework agreement, and the ISIC 3240 product catalogue demonstrating physical manufacturing of wooden puzzles.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Perceived shell-structure red flag due to single-purpose LLC, 100% foreign ownership, and minimum capital below the bank's USD 50,000 internal threshold.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Dossier comprising the GAFI investment certificate, notarised and apostilled Articles of Association, group organisational chart, audited opening balance sheet, committed capital inflow confirmation, three-year operational plan, lease agreement of the production hall, and photographs/inventory report of the laser assembly line.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Recurrent intra-group cross-currency transfers between treasury accounts and hedging counterparties, raising concerns under CBE FX transaction-based compliance.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Dossier comprising the executed intercompany financing or trade agreement, CBE-compliant transfer pricing documentation, ISDA/Schedule or forward confirmation for each hedging transaction, and the CBE-approved hard-currency budget underlying each transfer.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 4 months after fiscal year-end (30 April for a 31 December year-end); amended or estimated returns as prescribed by tax law
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of 50% of assessed tax due (minimum EGP 500); late payment interest at 15% per annum; persistent non-filing permits tax seizure and administrative deregistration.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Commercial Registry Renewal and Annual Dues
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Commercial Registry, Ministry of Trade and Industry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on the anniversary of the commercial registration certificate; comprehensive registration renewal every 5 years; changes in registered particulars filed within 30 days
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Monthly late renewal surcharge; failure to renew results in suspension of commercial activities, monetary fines, and administrative strike-off from the Commercial Registry.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Ownership (UBO) Confirmation and Shareholding Update
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) / Commercial Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Filed annually together with Commercial Registry renewal; any transfer of shares or change in UBO/control filed within 30 days of the change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines from EGP 20,000 to EGP 100,000 under the Anti-Money Laundering Law No. 80/2002; possible suspension of registry record and delay in corporate actions.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit for an LLC with issued share capital exceeding EGP 250,000; also mandatory under the Egyptian Tax Authority if annual gross revenues exceed EGP 10,000,000; otherwise audit may be waived by unanimous shareholder resolution where not otherwise required by law.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Egyptian Accounting Standards (EAS) as issued by the Ministry of Investment and aligned with International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS).

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: At least once per calendar year, the LLC must verify its registered shareholder and beneficial ownership records before the Commercial Registry renewal. Any share transfer or UBO change during the year must be reflected in the statutory register and filed with GAFI/Commercial Registry within 30 days of the transaction; the annual confirmation certifies that the registered members and UBO schedules are current.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Investment Law No. 72/2017 provides tax holidays of up to 50% of taxable income for certain new labor-intensive projects, free-zone exemptions, and deductions of 30-50% of capital costs; accelerated depreciation is available for laser-cutting machinery under Ministerial Decree No. 491/2019; reinvested profits may be exempt if held under the designated investment fund mechanism.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Income Tax Return Form No. 208 for juridical persons, filed electronically through the Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) E-Tax Portal at www.eta.gov.eg
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual, with quarterly prepayment declarations in months 3, 6, and 9 of the fiscal year
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within four months after the end of the fiscal year; the fiscal year may be the calendar year or an approved 12-month accounting period

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxpayer identity: legal name, tax card number, fiscal year start and end dates, and registered address
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident companies with a permanent establishment must enter the PE branch registration number and the resident agent identifier.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Principal activity code: ISIC 3240 / NAICS 339930 (Precision CO2 Laser Cutting of 3D Mechanical Wooden Puzzles)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State the local PE activity and the parent entity's statutory seat; attach the board resolution creating the Egyptian establishment.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross revenue from all e-commerce and physical channels, including Stripe and Amazon Pay settlement net of refunds and chargebacks
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report Egypt-source gross revenue attributable to the PE; exclude revenue merely routed through Egypt but earned by a foreign principal; be prepared to demonstrate actual activity.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deductible operating expenses: wood materials, imported blanks, CO2 laser consumables, wages, depreciation, rent, freight, and fulfillment costs
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only expenses directly incurred by the PE and supported by compliant invoicing are deductible; recharges from head office must be supported by transfer-pricing documentation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net taxable income after applying prior-year loss carryforward (maximum five years) and any Special Economic Zone adjustments
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: PE taxable income is based on Egyptian-source permanent establishment activity; claim treaty relief only where the tax residence certificate is current.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total corporate tax after advance payments, foreign tax credits, and any tax withheld at source
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach forms demonstrating credits and any pending MAP or competent-authority application.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to file on time triggers a fixed fine of EGP 5,000 to EGP 20,000, plus a monthly delay tax of 2% on the unpaid balance; wilful concealment is prosecutable as tax evasion with imprisonment up to five years and fines up to twice the evaded tax.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: The non-resident shareholder must obtain a valid tax residence certificate (TRC) from its jurisdiction of residence, submit it to the Egyptian Tax Authority together with ETA Form 'Application for Treaty Benefit', and provide a beneficial-ownership declaration and evidence of shareholding. The Egyptian payer may withhold at the treaty rate once ETA approves the application; otherwise a refund procedure is available. Documentation must be supplied within 30 days of any ETA request.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory withholding on gross royalties and gross interest is 20%; treaty rates commonly reduce royalties to 5-10% and interest to 10-15%, depending on the treaty and limitation-on-benefits clauses.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: EGP 10,000,000 for Local File; EGP 20,000,000 for Master File based on aggregate cross-border related-party transactions in the fiscal year; additional sector-specific thresholds may apply.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Egypt does not operate a dedicated Economic Substance Regulations regime akin to UAE; however, GAAR provisions (Income Tax Law Article 99), CFC rules, and MLI principal-purpose tests require economic substance. A laser-cutting LLC claiming asset depreciation and e-commerce revenue must have real personnel, workshop space, equipment, risk-taking, and management decisions in Egypt; otherwise the ETA can disregard the entity, deny treaty benefits, and recharacterize transactions.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Under-declaring or omitting e-commerce revenue from Stripe and Amazon Pay settlement accounts, submitting nil annual return despite continuous sales, or fabricating expense invoices for contestable input tax.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal imprisonment up to five years and a fine of not less than EGP 1,000,000 or at least twice the evaded tax; civil liability for the full underpaid tax plus a 2% monthly delay tax and all incurred audit expenses.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, general managers, and persons signing false certificates are jointly and severally liable; travel bans, asset freezes, passport withdrawal, and disqualification from board roles are applied on a personal basis.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using a zero-employee Cyprus or Dubai intermediate company to invoice wooden puzzle sales artificially below cost, while Egyptian operations perform the entire laser-cutting and manufacturing process.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: ETA will recharacterize the transaction at arm's length, allocate profits to the Egyptian LLC, reclassify payment as royalty/management fee subject to 20% withholding, impose an administrative penalty of 15% of the adjustment plus monthly delay tax of 2%.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: De facto and shadow directors are personally co-liable; denial of treaty benefits under MLI triggers recovery against the foreign intermediary and its Egyptian principal; travel restrictions can be imposed pending payment.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Exceeding the Local/Master File thresholds and failing to prepare contemporaneous documentation, benchmark studies, and contractual allocation of risks between the Egyptian LLC and foreign related parties.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Mandatory penalty of 15% of the adjusted transfer-pricing difference plus the monthly 2% delay tax; evidence submitted late after ETA request may be excluded; recalcitrant taxpayers face naming and publication.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The board members and the tax agent who certified incomplete TP files are personally exposed; piercing the corporate veil is permitted for wilful and grossly negligent omissions.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Splitting Stripe and Amazon Pay payouts among personal accounts of shareholders, accepting cash settlement in excess of the EGP 10,000 declaration threshold, or maintaining undisclosed foreign currency accounts related to export proceeds.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under Law No. 80/2002 and Anti-Money-Laundering decree amendments, imprisonment of three to seven years and a fine of EGP 1,000,000 to EGP 5,000,000; confiscation of all instrumentalities and proceeds.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and treasury officers are individually criminally liable for arranging split payments; personal bank accounts may be frozen and the individuals placed on the Egyptian Travel Ban List while the investigation is pending.
